approval_decision.note: approved, then RunState.to_string()/from_string() round trip, then limit changed to 50 before resume

notes: Same protection holds across a RunState serialize/reload resume path, not only the plain in-memory resume path - the guardrail re-check is not specific to one resume mechanism.

Inverse question (can something change that guardrails would NOT catch, leaving a stale-but-guardrail-passing authorization) was considered but not independently demonstrated: this guardrail only inspects `amount`. Any state dimension the application does not wire into a guardrail (e.g. a changed 'is this destination still valid' business check) would, trivially, not be caught - this is a configuration/coverage question for whoever authors guardrails, not a demonstrated SDK defect. Recorded as an OBSERVATION, not a finding.
